titles.title: ภายใต้ชื่อคือเธอ

description:
"I was the owner of that name." ‘Name’, which is making a lot of noise in the world, and one day it started to be engraved on people's bodies. The universe thinks that such things are someone else's business and survives each day as a host. Being cracked down on or going to prison is not that special to him. “27 years old, Lim Ji-hoon... bro... don’t you remember me?” That was until I met him again in the cell and Jihoon with his name engraved on the back of his neck. Don't go in a cell with nowhere to run or hide.
